question: Who among the following is known as the 'Missile Man' of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**APJ Abdul Kalam**.__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **APJ Abdul Kalam** is also known as the **"Missile Man of India."**
 
• He, joined ISRO in 1969 where he was the project head of India's first satellite launch vehicle "**Satellite Launch Vehicle-III**"
 
• In the 1970's he also directed two projects which developed ballistic missiles from the technology of the SLV program.
 
• **APJ Kalam** also served as the **Chief Scientific Adviser** to **Prime Minister** and he also served as a **Chief Project Co-ordinator** of the **Pokhran-II nuclear tests**.
 
• He has received **Bharat Ratna** and played a major role in the testing of nuclear weapons in 1998 during The Vajpayee Government.
 
• He also served as the **11th** **President of India** from the year 2002 to 2007.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• MF Hussain, full name Maqbool Fida Hussain(1915-2011) was an Indian artist known for executing bold, vibrantly colored narrative paintings. He was the most celebrated and internationally recoganised Indian artist in the 20th century.
 
• Homi Bhabha, full name Homi Jehangir Bhabha(1909-1966) was an Indian Nuclear Physicist, founding director and professor at the Tata Institute of Research. Also known as 'Father of the Indian Nuclear Programme'
 
• Rajiv Gandhi(1994-1991) served as the 6th Prime Minister of India from 1984-1989 and also the younger minister at the age of 40. In 1991, posthumously he was awarded Bharat Ratna, the highest civilian award.
